Provides extension methods for drawing UI shapes such as bars and outlines for rectangles and circles.

Remarks

These methods are intended for rendering progress bars, outlines, and similar UI elements with customizable appearance.

Methods

DrawBar(Rect, Vector2, float, float, ColorRgba, ColorRgba, float, float, float, float)

Draws a filled bar inside a rotated rectangle, representing progress with customizable margins and colors.

public static void DrawBar(this Rect rect, Vector2 pivot, float angleDeg, float f, ColorRgba barColorRgba, ColorRgba bgColorRgba, float left = 0, float right = 1, float top = 0, float bottom = 0)

Parameters

rect Rect

The rectangle to draw the bar in.

pivot Vector2

The pivot point for rotation.

angleDeg float

The rotation angle in degrees.

f float

The progress value (0 to 1) indicating how much of the bar to fill.

barColorRgba ColorRgba

The color of the filled bar.

bgColorRgba ColorRgba

The background color of the rectangle.

left float

The left margin left * (1 - f) to determine the fill behavior (default 0).

right float

The right margin right * (1 - f) to determine the fill behavior (default 1).

top float

The top margin top * (1 - f) to determine the fill behavior (default 0).

bottom float

The bottom margin bottom * (1 - f) to determine the fill behavior (default 0).

Examples

  • left 1, right 0, top 0, bottom 0 -> bar fills from right to left.
  • left 0, right 0, top 1, bottom 0 -> bar fills from bottom to top.
  • left 0, right 0, top 0, bottom 1 -> bar fills from top to bottom.
  • left 0.5, right 0.5, top 0, bottom 0 -> bar fills from center to left and right edges.

Remarks

The bar is drawn inside the rectangle, with the filled area shrinking as the progress value increases. The default margin values represent a bar that fills from the left to the right. The rectangle is rotated around the specified pivot point.

DrawOutlineBar(Circle, float, float, ColorRgba)

Draws an outline bar along the circumference of a circle, filling the outline based on the specified progress value.

public static void DrawOutlineBar(this Circle c, float thickness, float f, ColorRgba color)

Parameters

c Circle

The circle to draw the outline on.

thickness float

The thickness of the outline.

f float

The progress value (0 to 1) indicating how much of the outline to draw (as a fraction of the circle).

color ColorRgba

The color of the outline.

Remarks

The outline is drawn as a sector of the circle, starting from 0 degrees.

DrawOutlineBar(Rect, Vector2, float, float, float, ColorRgba)

Draws an outline bar along the border of a rotated rectangle, filling the outline based on the specified progress value.

public static void DrawOutlineBar(this Rect rect, Vector2 pivot, float angleDeg, float thickness, float f, ColorRgba color)

Parameters

rect Rect

The rectangle to draw the outline on.

pivot Vector2

The pivot point for rotation.

angleDeg float

The rotation angle in degrees.

thickness float

The thickness of the outline.

f float

The progress value (0 to 1) indicating how much of the outline to draw.

color ColorRgba

The color of the outline.

Remarks

The outline is drawn in four segments (top, right, bottom, left), and the progress value determines how many segments are filled. The rectangle is rotated around the specified pivot point.
